name: IELTS Academic
blurb: For university study in an English-speaking country.

sections.note: Four parts of 10 questions. Parts 1-2 everyday/social, Parts 3-4 educational. Heard once. Paper test adds 10 minutes to transfer answers.

raw.tableNote: Whole-band rows follow the published IELTS anchors (16=5, 23=6, 30=7, 35=8). Half-band rows are interpolated and indicative only.

sections.note: Three long passages, 2150-2750 words in total, increasing in difficulty.

raw.tableNote: Whole-band rows follow the published IELTS Academic anchors (15-18=5, 23-26=6, 30-32=7, 35-36=8, 39-40=9). Half-band rows are interpolated and indicative only.

sections.aggregateNote: Task 2 contributes twice as much as Task 1 to the Writing score.
